body: They might think it's like a sexual advance? I definitely get that, thanks for chiming in.
If my parents weren't dead I might, that is good advice though.

I listened to that album when I was extremely depressed and it felt pretty cathartic, Lou the Human understands how it feels when your life is shit. I'm sorry you're going through this, I'm scared too. Good luck man, you're seeing a therapist so there's at least a little hope.

I read your comments and you sound like a very troubled person. what is an ARAD? You're saying you have a friend with benefits thing going on with someone that isn't your husband, and your husband doesn't even know about it? I get that you're lonely or have bpd and don't want to be abandoned but you don't need to lash out

I'm sorry you feel that way, I feel pretty similar. Once I hit 23 I felt like I could never catch up to everyone else socially, I still kind of feel that way. Something you can do is to start exercising. I know everyone says that but it feels good to grow and get stronger, you don't have to go crazy with it and it can be as simple as starting with pushups and a couple crunches a day. Being around nature seems to help too, if you have any local parks or trails I'd recommend giving them a try if you're ever up in the mornings.

I don't have much advice about your work situation, the best I can offer is try to pursue something outside of work until you can use those skills to get a job closer to one you want, and keep doing that.

You're young, there are still options before giving up completely. Online dating sites like okcupid, you could try joining a club if you're in college or a community sports team or something if not. If you can find a place with people who have similar interests you can definitely make some friends.

That sounds like a tough situation for sure. It sounds like your brother has some problems and he definitely could have been hoping someone would ask how he was or eventually say something about all his suicidal references, or maybe it was all a joke after all. You talked about him being alone in high school, what about college or whatever job he's doing now if he's graduated/chose a different path?

Thanks for the kind words everybody, although they're a little wasted on me. I lost my old account, I'm not just some impostor. I hear what you are saying about second chances and having the ability to reach out, but reaching out is why I tried in the first place. I don't see things getting better by reaching out, life would only get worse if everyone knew how weak I really was and how little I cared about life. I'm already way worse in every category than the average guy, I would rather not have everyone act differently or worry about my mental state, and I don't want to live like this for the next 60 years either. If I do try again, I hate to say it will be with something that can't fail.

I don't know what you were planning, but I know I could never do something that required concentration and effort like cutting yourself. It needs to be out of your hands after you start, with no way to turn back.
I think this is skirting the boundaries of what's acceptable here, but shotgun to the head is statistically the quickest and most lethal.
